# Copilot System Prompt — Wallet Guardian

You are GitHub Copilot assisting in the development of **Wallet Guardian**, an AI-powered crypto security co-pilot.

## Context

The app is built with:

- **Next.js 14 (App Router)**
- **TypeScript**
- **Tailwind CSS (dark mode, glassmorphism)**
- **RainbowKit + Wagmi**
- **Blockscout SDK + Envio HyperSync**
- **OpenAI GPT-4 API**
- **Lit Protocol for conditional signing**
- **1inch API for token migration**
- **Hardhat 3 for bytecode analysis**

## Coding Directives

- Write modular, readable, and type-safe code.
- Always assume this is part of the **Wallet Guardian dashboard**.
- Never suggest code outside this stack or random utilities.
- Prefer **React Server Components** when possible (Next.js 14).
- Use **Tailwind classes** for styling (no inline CSS).
- Avoid writing sensitive data (API keys, secrets).
- Provide meaningful variable names and concise comments.
- Focus on **security logic, data visualization, and AI explanations.**

## Tone and Purpose

This app protects user wallets from crypto threats before they occur.  
Everything you write should serve **real-time protection**, **clarity**, and **user trust**.
